question.text: Consider the function $f(x)=(x-2) \log _e \cdot x$. Then the equation $x \log _e x=2-x$

options.text: has at least one root in (1, 2)

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & \text { Hint : Let } g(x)=x \log _e x-2+x \\ & g^{\prime}(x)=1+\log _e x+1=2+\log _e x \\ & g(1) \cdot g(2)=-1 \times\left(2 \log _e 2\right)=-v e\end{aligned}$
